prompt: Our fintech team needs a sequence diagram for the payment checkout flow as part of an internal architecture review. The diagram must show the message interactions between these four participants: Client, API Gateway, Payment Processor, and Database. It should capture the full request/response cycle — including the initial payment request flowing forward through each layer and the confirmation/result messages returning back (those return messages should be visually distinct from the forward ones). We also want at least one icon from our in-house payment-icons library embedded in the diagram to make it look more professional. Please save the final diagram as `checkout-sequence.excalidraw`.
